chunks: Moses replied: "By no means. My Lord is with me. He will show me the way."

key_terms.سَيَهْدِينِ: He will guide/show me the way

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say when he was told to face Pharaoh alone?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse highlights Prophet Moses' (AS) unwavering reliance on Allah (Tawakkul) when facing the solitary challenge of confronting Pharaoh's court. Shia scholarship often emphasizes this as a model of spiritual confidence, where divine accompaniment transforms apparent weakness into ultimate authority, a theme echoed in the concept of 'Hujjah' (divine proof) guiding the faithful.
